NSA Doval Warns Against Mistaking India's Tolerance for Weakness

National Security Advisor Ajit Doval stated that India's generosity and tolerance should not be perceived as weakness. He issued a warning, asserting that India "can hit hard." Doval made these remarks in relation to 'Operation Sindoor'. The coverage did not specify the exact nature or timing of Operation Sindoor.
